Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the analysis of the thermal energy flow. The correct description of the flow is from the tea to the ice (option B), as thermal energy always flows from a hotter object (tea) to a colder object (ice) until equilibrium is reached. However, the Planner incorrectly stated that the best description is "C) both directions until equilibrium," which is inaccurate because the net flow of thermal energy is unidirectional (from tea to ice) due to their temperature difference. This misunderstanding led to the wrong conclusion.
